description: Get a transparent, all-in fare quote for a Quo black-car ride in Florida. No account needed, the same price shown on the public site. Returns a line-item breakdown and the total. Pass pickup and dropoff to have the trip routed and priced by distance exactly as a reservation is; without them the total is an estimate before routing, and a longer trip costs more when it is reserved.

eventSlug.description: Slug of an event on the Quo calendar (see list_events) if this ride is tied to one, affects demand pricing

hours.description: Hours booked, for service=hourly (minimum 2); defaults to 3 if omitted. Ignored for service=transfer.

pickup.description: Pickup address, airport, or hotel. With dropoff (or for hourly, alone), the trip is routed and the quote includes distance, as a reservation's would.

service.description: transfer = point-to-point; hourly = by the hour, as directed

vehicle.description: Vehicle class: sedan (Executive Sedan), suv (Luxury SUV), sprinter (Executive Sprinter), flagship (Flagship)

name: get_quote
title: Get a fare quote
